comment: A torrent finished inside a profile's folder (relative to the library root) is queued with that profile; the deepest matching folder wins. Results go to output/<results>, the profile's name when results is not given. args go to convert_eng.py as they are.

web.about: English audio, English subtitles burnt in, at most 1080p

web-rus.about: Russian audio, no subtitles, at most 1080p, into web's folder

bmw.about: as web, cropped and scaled to the car's 1920x700 screen

bmw-rus.about: as bmw, Russian audio, no subtitles, into bmw's folder

ipad-rus.about: Russian audio, no subtitles, small, at most 720p
